description:
Create a monthly savings plan for an ETF in Portfolio Performance. A portfolio file is available at /home/ga/Documents/PortfolioData/savings_plan.xml containing the 'Vanguard FTSE All-World UCITS ETF'.

Open this file (if not already open) and configure a new Savings Plan with the following details:
- Security: Vanguard FTSE All-World UCITS ETF
- Account: Reference Account (EUR) / My Depot
- Interval: Monthly
- Amount: 500.00 EUR
- Start Date: April 1, 2026

Save the portfolio file once the plan is created.
